subject: Post-demo: SDK integration milestones & ownership — draft commitments
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit@novushealth.com>, Priya Menon <priya.m@novushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: SDK integration milestones & ownership — draft commitments

Hi Amit / Priya —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our side and a proposed set of commitments to land the MAP milestone "Integration build plan" (SDK + streaming + tool-calls + structured outputs). I captured items we discussed and assigned tentative owners so we have something concrete to iterate on.

Summary (high level)
- Goal: have a working SDK integration in Novus staging that supports streaming responses, tool-calling hooks, and structured JSON outputs for the patient-summary flow.
- Target close / MVP date: 2026-09-03 (we discussed early Sept).

Draft milestones & owners (first pass)
1) Authentication & onboarding (API key + env): Owner — Novus IT (Priya) / Redwood onboarding (Marissa) — due 2026-07-30
2) SDK integration (server-side) — Owner: Karthik (Redwood) + Novus eng rep (Amit) — due 2026-08-13
3) Streaming & client hooks — Owner: Karthik — due 2026-08-20
4) Tool-calling adapter (EHR lookup endpoint) — Owner: Novus IT (Priya) + Redwood eng (Jordan) — due 2026-08-27
5) Structured output schema & validation (patient-summary v1) — Owner: Novus product (Amit) + Soojin (Redwood PM) — due 2026-08-27
6) End-to-end staging validation & perf run — Owner: Novus eng + Redwood SRE — due 2026-09-03

Dependencies & blockers we flagged
- Novus must expose a secure EHR lookup endpoint w/ access token for tool-calls (blocker until Priya confirms)
- SDK integration will require a short compatibility shim for your logging pipeline (we can provide a sample)
- Streaming behavior depends on your client session model — we recommended the continuous-chunk model we demoed.

Ask / next steps
- Priya / Amit: please confirm ownership of the Novus-side owners above and any date adjustments by EOD Fri (2026-07-24).
- Marissa / Karthik / Jordan: we will produce a first MAP workbook (attached) and a one-page SDK checklist to hand to Novus eng.
- I'll schedule a 30-min follow-up next week to lock owners and mark dependencies in HubSpot.

Attachments: RDW_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), sdk_integration_checklist.pdf (one-page dev checklist)

Thanks — happy to adjust items; wanted to get something concrete into your inbox to keep momentum.

Best,

Soojin Lee
Product Manager, Integrations
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0143

From: Amit Shah <amit@novushealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.m@novushealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 17:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: SDK integration milestones & ownership — draft commitments

Hi Soojin —

Thanks for the clear recap and the attachments. Overall this looks good and aligns with what we discussed. A few notes on our side: 

- Priya owns the EHR endpoint and will confirm whether we can expose a scoped service account by Friday. If that’s doable, we can hit the 7/30 auth milestone.
- On SDK integration: Amit (me) will be the Novus eng lead; I’ll pair with Karthik for the initial implementation.
- Tool-calling: we’ll need a brief data contract for the EHR lookup response (fields and max payload). I can draft that and share with Soojin by Monday (2026-07-27).

One question: for structured outputs, can Redwood provide an initial JSON schema sample tied to the patient-summary flow? That will help our product and validators.

I’ll confirm owners + timeline after Priya’s check. Look forward to the follow-up.

Thanks,
Amit
Senior Engineering Manager
Novus Health
amit@novushealth.com

From: Priya Menon <priya.m@novushealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Amit Shah <amit@novushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2026 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: SDK integration milestones & ownership — draft commitments

On Thu, Jul 22, 2026 at 5:22 PM Amit Shah <amit@novushealth.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the clear recap and the attachments. Overall this looks good and aligns with what we discussed. 

Thanks Soojin — quick update from Novus IT: we can provide a scoped service account token for the EHR lookup endpoint. I’m confirming the token rotation policy and will send a short spec (token TTL, scopes, cert requirements) by Friday 2026-07-24.

Blocking question for Redwood: does the SDK checklist include recommended retry/backoff settings for the streaming connection? We have a flaky mobile client and want to follow best practices.

Priya
Senior Director, IT Ops
Novus Health
priya.m@novushealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Priya Menon <priya.m@novushealth.com>, Amit Shah <amit@novushealth.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: SDK integration milestones & ownership — draft commitments

Thanks for the quick confirmations — putting the next concrete items here so we can update HubSpot and the MAP workbook: 

Actions I’m taking (Redwood)
- Marissa: publish RDW_MAP_v1.xlsx into the shared Drive folder and create HubSpot tasks for each milestone by EOD 2026-07-24.
- Karthik: deliver SDK starter repo + sample streaming client and recommended retry/backoff config (RFC) by 2026-07-29.
- Jordan: draft a tool-calling adapter example for the EHR lookup (Node + Python) by 2026-08-06.
- Soojin: consolidate Novus feedback into MAP v1 and confirm target close date next sync.

Requests from Novus we captured
- Priya: token TTL and scope spec (by 2026-07-24)
- Amit: sample JSON schema for patient-summary structured output (Amit requested date: 2026-07-27)

Next sync: I’ll schedule a 30-min owner sync for Tue 2026-07-28 10:00 AM PT — please confirm availability. If we get owners and the token spec this week, we’ll be on track for the 2026-09-03 MVP close.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Onboarding
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
